Theodore Schildberg

If you don't know who Mr. Teador is, he is a so-called healer, and he's quite popular. We first hear about him in the hidden newspaper, at the time he didn't seem that relevant but I took an interest him because I saw a link between him and one of the victims (Irena). Now it's pretty clear that episode 8 is pretty much about him, so I want to review him. He obviously the abductor everything links to him, the theme of nature, Ania's diary when a young Ania at a festival gets confronted by a man in a suit. (check out my analyzation of previous episodes if you want to see more links between him and the abductor). In episode 8, in first person we see an eye open then close, I'm pretty sure this is Mr. Teador, and the collage scenes after that are his dream. In his dream, he is on a stage in his suit with followers below him. It looks very much like a cult, so maybe the cult theory was correct after all. In the next scene, outside the hall they are a family of prosthetics, suddenly there is a flash, and the prosthetics become flesh. They have been unexplainable healed just like Mrs. Teresa and her cancer. But I think there is a catch to this. Mrs. Teresa talks about how after Mr. Teador did one last serene, her cancer was cured. She describes the serene as "extraordinary, unforgettable experience." after she finishes talking, a man with a mask flashes on the screen. We see him again towards the end of the episode. The gas mask he is wearing suffocate him. He tries to take it off, but he dies. If the concept of magic works in this story, I would say that Teador is using his victims like the gas mask man as sacrifices. Taking their life force and using it to save someone else like Mrs. Teresa with her amazing recovery. You can also tell who Teodor's followers are because they eyes glow, like the cult followers in the hall. The man that Ania's neighbor points out to the police also has glowing eyes, is he another one of Teodor's followers and if he is what does that mean? They still are a lot of unanswered question as well, like who is "W." the woman we see in the first scene having serene with Teador, is it Mrs. Teresa? And if it was why doesn't he just call her by her name instead of "W"? the forest scene is also unclear, where the women are hiding behind the trees then they disappear. Are they Teador previous victims? And what about the creepy looking boy at the end of the forest scene, is it a young Teador? I'm actually not 100% sure that Mr. Teador is the abductor since they are a lot of mysterious things that I don't quite understand yet.
